To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.

Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICSI Executive (Career Awareness Programme) Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 26-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICSI to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICSI Executive (Career Awareness Programme) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the ICSI Executive (Career Awareness Programme) posts is 26 September 2026. Ensure you submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBA / PGDBM or an equivalent degree/diploma with at least 50% marks and a specialization in Marketing. The degree/diploma should be of at least 2-year duration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Executive (Career Awareness Programme) post is 40 years as of 01 September 2026. Age relaxation will be provided as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Executive post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Executive (Career Awareness Programme) position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Executive post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the Executive (Career Awareness Programme) post announced by The Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the ICSI Executive (Career Awareness Programme) recruitment is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official ICSI website.

faq.question: Q7. What are the locations where the Executive will be posted?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for positions in Kolkata, Mumbai, and Chennai.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Executive (Career Awareness Programme) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for this recruitment will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for the ICSI Executive (Career Awareness Programme) recruitment begins on 12 September 2026.
